mapper.select: select ar.id, ar.employee_id, ar.access_datetime, ar.device_name, ar.resource_name, ar.person_name, si.class_section, si.id_name, m.user_id as parent_user_id from attendance_record ar inner join ${studentProfilesDatabase}.student_info si on si.student_id collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci = ar.employee_id inner join sys_student_match m on m.student_id collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci = ar.employee_id where ar.is_notified = '0' and ar.employee_id is not null and ar.employee_id != '' and m.user_id is not null and m.user_id != '' order by ar.id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update attendance_record set is_notified = '1' where id = #{id} and is_notified = '0'
